text:
maya: Heads-up — structured-output eval runner started failing on quantized model (llama-3-8q) for function-call tests. CI dashboard shows a ton of "invalid_schema" rows even though the GitHub checks are green. Anyone seen this?

liam: I noticed a spike earlier today, thought it was noise. Could be the strictness change we rolled. @andre any ideas?

andre: I flipped the new flag `--strict-json` in PR #482 to catch extra fields. That will reject outputs with additionalProperties. Example from logs: 
```
Model output:
{"tool_call": {"name": "lookup_price", "args": {"symbol": "AAPL", "extra": "x"}}}
Schema error: additionalProperties not allowed: extra at /tool_call/args
```

sara: Why did CI pass then? Our unit tests mock a lenient validator, so runner-level validation could still fail in integration.

ci-bot: all checks passed for commit 4f2a1c (build 321) :white_check_mark:

maya: I just ran locally: `pytest tests/evals/test_structured.py::test_function_calls -k quantized` and I get the same validation exception. Command I used: `python -m eval_runner --config evals/configs/quantized_func_call.yaml`

liam: My hunch: dashboard uses an older canonical schema (evals/schemas/func_calls_v1.json) while the runner is loading the new stricter schema (func_calls_v2.json). Mismatch -> inconsistent pass/fail.

andre: Confirmed. CI job `eval/spec` pulls schema from the repo at HEAD (v1), but the runner in prod image has baked-in v2 in /opt/eval/schemas. We need single source of truth. Options: fetch canonical schema from S3 during job start or pin the runner to use repo schema.

zaha: Also flagging metric drift: our metric `function_call_exact_match` treats extra args as failure. For models that add optional metadata we want a tolerant metric. Suggest adding `normalized_args_match` that ignores unknown keys unless required.

sara: Agreed. We should canonicalize args before validation: sort keys, drop non-whitelisted extras unless `allow_extra: true` in schema metadata. That would fix brittle regressions.

maya: I'm prepping a patch: 1) runner falls back to repo schema URL if local validation fails 2) add a pre-validation canonicalizer that sorts keys and strips unknowns per schema allowlist 3) add test cases to CI that exercise quantized model outputs. Will open PR in ~30m.

liam: Also request: dashboard should show raw model output blob for failed rows (not just schema error). That would speed debugging. Currently we only surface error counts.

andre: I'll add a column in the reporting pipeline to persist raw `model_output` for failed cases into the debug store (S3 bucket `redwood-eval-debug`). We should rotate/expire after 30 days.

ci-bot: build queued: eval-runner patch #486 (job 332) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: One more: update metric def docs. I'll add a section to evals/metrics.md about tolerant vs strict function-call metrics and include examples.

maya: Thanks all — PR incoming. Will ping for reviews. :pray:

liam: ACK, will review after standup. :+1:

zaha: Thanks, this should reduce noisy alerts in the quality dashboards.

ci-bot: job 332 started on runner-prod-12 :gear:
